magma_memory_adapter — SemanticMemoryPort backed by MAGMA multi-graph.

Bridges the MemoryPort concept to the MagmaGraph relational store. Four orthogonal graphs (semantic, temporal, entity, causal) provide structured retrieval per MAGMA (arXiv:2601.03236).

Compile with -d:withPostgres to activate.

../../core/types, ../../ports/memory, ../../ports/embedding, ../../ports/reranking, ../../domain/memory/commitment_pure, ../../domain/memory/episode_pure, ../../domain/memory/lessons_pure, magma_graph, pgvector_store, ../../domain/memory/graph_pure, ../../domain/memory/rrf
